name: tutticode
description: Your agent writes music as code and renders it to WAV, FLAC or MP3 (with stems, an exact length and a loudness target) in your own browser, on the TuttiDAW engine. Every render comes with a link that opens it in TuttiDAW to keep editing.

interface.shortDescription: Write music as code, render it to audio
interface.longDescription:
TuttiCode is a pattern language for music, a superset of Strudel that plays on TuttiDAW's instruments and effects. With this plugin your agent writes a program, checks it, and renders it to WAV, FLAC or MP3: an exact length in seconds, bars or loops, stems per voice, fades, a loudness target with a true-peak ceiling, and a report with the bar grid, loudness and per-voice levels. It can compare a render with goals and revise.

Rendering happens in your own browser (Chrome or Edge) on the same engine as tuttidaw.com/code: nothing is rendered on a server and it is free. Every render returns an editUrl that opens the program in TuttiDAW, so a person can keep editing it.

Runs through the tutticode npm package (Node 20+). Without an account renders are limited to 60 s and those over 30 s carry a spoken tag; a free account (tutticode login) lifts both.
defaultPrompt: Make a 12-second lo-fi intro bed for my video at -16 LUFS, with a 1.5 s fade-out.
Write a looping 8-bar battle theme for my game and give me the stems.
Make UI sounds for my app: a click, a confirm and an error, as short WAV files.
